scope: Prospective phase only. Specifies how the registered passGates and the oneShot rule are computed. Committed before the prospective window opens (2026-10-10T00:00:00Z); no prospective row has been fetched or read. The retrospective phase and its recorded result are unchanged.
oneShot: The runner refuses the phase if its results.json already exists. It stages returns.json and results.json durably and renames them into place read-only, results.json last, as the completion marker. A run interrupted before results.json is published may be repeated with identical inputs; a published result is final.
medianSeed: Per combo, the seed with the median base net return over the phase window. Every stress uses that same seed.
fleetAggregation: Per-bar net returns of each combo's median seed are compounded into UTC calendar days by bar open time. Fleet daily return = equal-weight mean of the three combos. Baselines (buy-and-hold, 20-bar momentum) are aggregated identically from each combo's baseline returns.
fleetStatistics: Fleet PSR uses daily returns; lifetimeAdjustedPsr = max(0, 1 - min(1, 3261 * (1 - PSR))). Annualized Sharpe uses 365 periods per year. Max drawdown is on the compounded fleet daily path.
doubledCosts: A separate engine run per chunk with --backtest-cost-multiplier 2, which multiplies fee (including fixed and minimum fees), slippage, impact, spread and funding after combo adoption. Fleet doubled-cost return is aggregated like the base return.
oneBarDelay: A separate engine run per chunk with --backtest-signal-delay-bars 1: the decision at bar t uses bar t-1's predicted return (rescaled to bar t's price) and gate metadata; fills, stops and costs use bar t. Fleet delayed return is aggregated as above.
decision: PASS only if every registered passGate holds: every combo NOT_REJECTED; fleet lifetimeAdjustedPsr >= 0.95; fleet max drawdown <= 20%; fleet annualized Sharpe above both fleet baselines; fleet net2x return > 0; fleet delayed return > 0. Otherwise REJECTED.
validation: The delay flag and stress computations are tested only on rows before createdAtMs (2026-03-25T17:38:18Z) before any prospective evaluation.
pinnedHaskellTreeNote: git rev-parse HEAD:haskell of the commit that implements these gates. The prospective run must use a clean checkout whose haskell/ tree equals this hash; the runner builds trader-hs there and records tree, commit and binary sha256.

revisions.change: Doubled costs moved from net-minus-gross arithmetic (which mixes return denominators) to an engine rerun with --backtest-cost-multiplier 2; added pinnedHaskellTree and atomic publication. Made after the window opened, before any prospective row was fetched or read, in response to review on PR #330.
